title: Change and manage (Wave 1)
env: Environment: dtp.ltsgroup.tech (web test) · Screenshots taken 06 Nov 2026 · Prepared by QA
intro: Wave 1 use cases that Flows 1–3 do not cover: viewing and changing users, roles and consultants, the permission matrices, the display language, customer accounts (SGS Admin), editing and withdrawing a framework, editing a scope and a certification cycle, the effective scope of a workspace, requirement owners, evidence in the library (upload without mapping, link, unlink, edit, delete), archiving and deleting workspaces, and signing out.

It reuses the data of Flow 3 (framework, scope and workspace "[QA] D05 Smoke Assisted … 0851"). Steps go from the least to the most final action, so archiving the workspace and withdrawing the framework come last.
Red boxes and labels were added for this document. Dates on screen are in Taiwan time (UTC+8); the bar above each screenshot shows Vietnam time (GMT+7).

steps.what: Open a user and check their details.
steps.result: Profile, status, role and the scopes the user can see.
body: The list shows role, scope access, status and last sign-in for every user of the organisation.
shots: User details: profile, status, role and scope access.

steps.what: Change the role of a user.
steps.result: The new role applies; the user is told.
body: Roles on the Customer Portal: Admin, User, Viewer. At least one Customer Admin must remain.
shots: Change role: pick the new role and Save role.

steps.what: Manage a Customer Consultant hired by the organisation.
steps.result: The Customer Admin can deactivate and later reactivate the consultant.
body: A Customer Consultant works only through the requests assigned to them. The Deactivate dialog was opened and cancelled, so the consultant stays active.
shots: Customer Consultant details: Deactivate (opened and cancelled).

steps.what: Check the permission matrix of the Customer Portal roles.
steps.result: Read-only matrix for Admin, User, Viewer and Consultant.
shots: Roles & permissions: read-only matrix of the Customer Portal.

steps.what: Switch the display language.
steps.result: Screens show the chosen language; the choice is saved for the user.
body: English and 繁體中文 (Traditional Chinese). The language was switched back to English after the screenshot.
shots: The same page in 繁體中文.

steps.what: Find a customer account and open it.
steps.result: Account details with Overview, Users, Scopes and Certifications.
body: The list shows users, scopes, workspaces and status for every customer of the SGS affiliate.

steps.where: SGS Portal > Customers > customer detail > Edit account
steps.what: Edit the name or contact of the customer account.
steps.result: The new contact is saved.
body: The SGS affiliate is set at creation and cannot be changed. Phone numbers accept digits and + - ( ) only.
shots: The new phone number on the account.

steps.what: Manage an SGS-side consultant (SGS employee or Freelancer).
steps.result: The SGS Admin can edit, deactivate and reactivate the consultant.
body: The consultant details show the type, consulting firm and Marketplace visibility. No change was saved in this run.
shots: Consultants tab: SGS employees and Freelancers.

steps.what: Check the permission matrix of the SGS Portal roles.
steps.result: Read-only matrix for SGS Admin and Consultant.
shots: Roles & permissions: read-only matrix of the SGS Portal.

steps.where: SGS Portal > Frameworks > framework detail > Edit details
steps.what: Edit the framework details.
steps.result: Names, standard edition, issuing body and description are saved.
body: Code and content version come from the import and cannot be edited.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Scopes > scope detail > Edit scope
steps.what: Edit the scope fields.
steps.result: The scope is saved with the new values.
body: The scope type cannot be changed after the scope is created.
shots: The scope with the new Out of scope text.

steps.what: Check the effective scope of the workspace.
steps.result: Only requirements up to the tier count; requirements above the tier or retired are out of scope.
body: The system works this out from the tier chosen when the workspace was created.
shots: Workspace summary: requirements in scope for tier Medium, and out of scope.
Requirements: rows above the tier are marked Out of scope.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Workspaces > workspace detail > Certification cycle > Edit
steps.what: Edit the certification cycle dates.
steps.result: The new dates are saved.
body: Only while the workspace is active; the end date must be after the start date.
shots: Edit the cycle: start and end dates.
The cycle with the new end date.

steps.what: Set the owner of a requirement.
steps.result: The requirement has an owner.
body: The owner must have access to the scope.

steps.what: Upload evidence to the library without mapping it.
steps.result: The evidence is in the library, Not mapped, and can be linked later.
body: The uploader chooses the owning scope. The file is scanned before it can be used.
shots: Create evidence: file, owning scope and title.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Documents > evidence detail > Edit details
steps.what: Edit the evidence details.
steps.result: Title, description and dates are saved.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Workspace > Requirements > requirement > Link existing evidence
steps.what: Link the library evidence to a requirement.
steps.result: The requirement uses the evidence and becomes Provided.
body: Only clean files can be linked.
shots: Link existing evidence: pick the item.
The evidence is linked; the requirement is Provided.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Workspace > Requirements > requirement > Remove
steps.what: Remove the evidence from the requirement.
steps.result: The link is removed; the evidence stays in the library.
shots: The requirement after the link is removed.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Documents > evidence detail > Delete
steps.what: Delete the evidence.
steps.result: The evidence, all its versions and links are deleted.
body: Bulk documents that are locked or sent cannot be deleted.
shots: Back on Documents after the deletion.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Workspaces > workspace detail > Archive
steps.what: Archive the workspace.
steps.result: The workspace is Archived and read-only.
body: Not possible while a consulting request is open or documents are being sent.

steps.where: Customer Portal > Workspaces > workspace detail > Delete
steps.what: Delete an empty workspace.
steps.result: The workspace is deleted.
body: Only a workspace with no evidence, no requests and no documents sent can be deleted. A new empty workspace was created for this step.

steps.where: SGS Portal > Frameworks > framework detail > Deactivate
steps.what: Withdraw the framework from new use.
steps.result: Customers can no longer create workspaces with it; existing workspaces keep it.

steps.what: Sign out.
steps.result: The session ends and the sign-in page opens.
body: On the SGS environment this also signs out of the Microsoft Entra session.

blocked: Signing out of the Entra session together with DTP.

After Sign out, opening DTP asks for the Entra sign-in again.
Blocking an infected file at upload. Normal uploads are tested.
Pending: the malware scanner CrowdStrike is not connected yet. SGS IT is connecting it on the SGS environment.
An infected file shows Blocked and cannot be linked, downloaded or used.
The email a user gets after a role change.
On the test environment email goes to Mailpit; real delivery depends on the SGS SMTP set-up.
The user receives the role-change email.
limitations: Deactivating consultants was opened and cancelled, so no consultant lost access during this run.
The workspace and framework of Flow 3 are archived and deactivated at the end of this flow; use a new framework and workspace to repeat Flow 3.
